issues.detail: The Greek 'απελυσεν' (apelysen) means 'to come to his senses,' 'to be brought to his senses,' or 'to be sobered up.' The Vietnamese translation 'cầu xin ở với Ngài' (begged to stay with Him) is a complete mistranslation of the verb's meaning.
The Greek 'εδεετο δε αυτου' implies the man was 'brought to his senses' by/because of Jesus, whereas the Vietnamese version misinterprets this as a request for companionship.
